name: unity-project-setup
description: Prepares a Unity project for AI-agent-driven development: layered asmdefs the compiler enforces, standard folders, Editor-applied project settings, Unity git files, AGENTS.md with a docs/ set agents keep current, coding/commit/collaboration rules and a tested EventBus.

interface.longDescription: Lays layered assemblies, project settings, git files and agent-ready docs onto a new Unity project so AI agents can work on it within clear rules.
defaultPrompt: Set up this Unity project with folders, assemblies and coding rules.
Get this Unity project ready for AI agents to work on in parallel.
